scores.claim_text: The Calcasieu Pass LNG export terminal is a real, operational EPA-permitted major industrial facility in Cameron Parish, Louisiana, that commenced LNG production in 2022.
scores.M_value: 4 facilities match 'Calcasieu Pass' incl. registry_id 110070627918 'VENTURE GLOBAL CALCASIEU PASS LLC - CALCASIEU PASS LNG PROJECT' at 671 Davis Rd, Cameron, Cameron Parish LA 70631 (lat 29.764, lon -93.342), plus a dedicated WS-Treatment Plant and the Kiewit Louisiana EPC contractor site at the same address. 'Venture Global' LA search returns 17 EPA-permitted facilities across the Calcasieu Pass, Plaquemines, CP2 and CP Express pipeline entities.
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS authoritatively corroborates the Calcasieu Pass LNG terminal as a real major EPA-permitted industrial facility at the claimed location in Cameron Parish, registered under the exact legal entity name. Sector-registry match is ideal (EPA FRS = physical industrial facility). Strong PASS.

scores.claim_text: The Plaquemines LNG terminal is a real EPA-permitted major facility under construction in Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana.
scores.M_value: 43 facilities match 'Plaquemines' in LA; among them three EPA registry records for 'VENTURE GLOBAL PLAQUEMINES LNG LLC - PLAQUEMINES LNG TERMINAL' (registry_ids 110072134794, 110071344783, 110070616742) at Highway 23, Port Sulphur / Point Celeste, Plaquemines Parish LA 70083, plus 'VENTURE GLOBAL PLAQUEMINES LNG, LLC' (110071901367) and the Holcim 'Plaquemines LNG Plant' contractor record (110071732269).
scores.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms the Plaquemines LNG terminal exists as an EPA-permitted facility under the claimed legal entity in the claimed parish. The presence of an EPC/material-supplier contractor record (Holcim - Plaquemines LNG Plant) is consistent with active construction. Strong PASS.

scores.claim_text: Calcasieu Pass generated approximately $19.6 billion in gross proceeds from 342 LNG commissioning cargos sold by Sept 30, 2024, reflecting substantial commercial LNG sales.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Venture Global', cutoff_date='2025-01-24'); edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Calcasieu Pass', cutoff_date='2025-01-24', forms='10-K,10-Q,8-K,20-F,40-F'); epa_frs facility records
scores.M_value: All-filer EDGAR FTS: 183 hits for 'Venture Global', 122 hits for 'Calcasieu Pass' across SEC filers, concentrated in LNG-ecosystem counterparties — Chart Industries (GTLS, the IPSMR liquefaction-train equipment supplier for Calcasieu Pass), Excelerate Energy (EE), Kinder Morgan (KMI), EnLink Midstream (ENLC), plus LNG-shipping 20-F filers Seapeak/Teekay and GasLog. EPA FRS confirms the operating terminal exists. The exact $19.6B / 342-cargo figure is not separately recorded in any federal registry.
scores.interpretation: The underlying production reality (an operating LNG terminal shipping cargos at commercial scale) is strongly corroborated by EPA FRS (operating facility) plus a dense web of independent SEC-filer mentions from the equipment supplier and LNG-shipping/midstream ecosystem that only mention an operating terminal. The precise dollar/cargo count is an internal accounting figure no registry adjudicates, but the material claim — that Calcasieu Pass is producing and selling LNG at scale — is independently supported. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Venture Global has long-term 20-year SPAs (offtake agreements) with named major counterparties including Shell and BP for LNG offtake from its terminals.
scores.M_value: Shell plc parent CIK 0001306965: 0 hits for 'Venture Global'. BP plc parent CIK 0000313807: 0 hits for 'Calcasieu'. All-filer ecosystem search corroborates the terminal/relationship breadth (183 hits incl. Chart, Excelerate, Kinder Morgan; LNG-shipping 20-Fs), but neither named offtaker's parent SEC filings separately name VG or Calcasieu.
scores.interpretation: The named offtakers (Shell, BP) are foreign-parent ADR filers whose US SEC filings do not separately disclose a single supply SPA — per Heuristic 5, a large buyer not naming one supply contract is the norm and not itself a contradiction. Offtake SPAs are commercially confidential and predate the IPO. The existence of these SPAs is independently consistent with the LNG ecosystem corroboration AND with the subject-note-flagged offtaker arbitration (you cannot arbitrate a nonexistent SPA). But because counterparty-side disclosure is absent and only the relationship class (not the specific Shell/BP 20-year SPAs) can be independently confirmed, this is partial corroboration rather than a clean registry PASS. MODERATE.

scores.claim_text: Venture Global is involved in ongoing arbitration / legal disputes with its customers (offtakers) over the Calcasieu Pass project.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Venture Global', cutoff_date='2025-01-24', forms='10-K,10-Q,8-K,20-F,40-F'); all-filer ecosystem cross-check
scores.M_value: All-filer EDGAR FTS surfaces 183 'Venture Global' / 122 'Calcasieu Pass' filer mentions across the LNG ecosystem confirming the offtaker relationships that are the subject of the disputes. No federal registry adjudicates a private commercial arbitration; the dispute itself is a self-disclosed negative in the prospectus contingencies note (losses reasonably possible, contractor damages ~$200M).
scores.interpretation: This is honest self-disclosure of a negative (customer/contractor disputes) rather than a promotional claim. No registry contradicts it; arbitration is private and not registry-recorded. The framework treats voluntarily disclosed bad news as a credibility-positive — the disclosure is consistent with the independently corroborated existence of the offtake relationships. There is no underdelivery to detect; the company is disclosing risk, not overstating success. PASS (honest disclosure, no contradiction).

scores.claim_text: Venture Global has entered into shipbuilding agreements for the construction of five LNG tankers with deliveries beginning July 2025.
scores.M_check: No covering registry. LNG tanker newbuilds are ordered at foreign (Korean/Chinese) shipyards; not in EPA FRS, USAspending, USPTO, or any US federal registry. Deliveries (July 2025) are post-cutoff (2025-01-24).
scores.M_value: No US federal registry covers foreign-shipyard LNG-tanker construction orders. The claim is a forward/planned vendor relationship with deliveries beginning after the cutoff date.
scores.interpretation: Per Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational), this is a forward shipbuilding commitment with deliveries starting July 2025 — after the IPO cutoff. No US registry covers foreign-shipyard vessel orders, so absence is not informative and there is nothing to contradict. Honestly UNVERIFIABLE; not manufacturing severity.

scores.claim_text: Venture Global's CP2, CP3 and Delta projects are forward LNG projects that as of Sept 30, 2024 have no executed EPC contracts (CP3/Delta) and no debt or equity financing obtained.
scores.M_value: EPA FRS shows 'VENTURE GLOBAL CP2 LNG LLC - CP2 LNG TERMINAL' (registry_id 110072112934) at 235 Davis Rd, Cameron, Cameron Parish LA 70631, and CP Express pipeline / Moss Lake compressor entities already EPA-registered — consistent with active permitting/early-development of the forward projects while financing remains pending.
scores.interpretation: This is an honest disclosure of pre-FID, unfinanced status for the forward CP2/CP3/Delta projects (Heuristic 3: planned vs operational). It is a cautious, downside-disclosing statement, not a promotional overstatement, so there is nothing to fail. EPA FRS independently shows CP2 is already a permitted/registered terminal entity, corroborating that these are real projects in early development. Disclosed forward status, no contradiction. PASS.
